name: openspec_route
description: Validate an OpenSpec execution DAG and select code_parallel or feature_campaign using conservative deterministic routing.

assessment.description: Planner's proposed execution assessment (rationale, confidence, risks, and a task DAG) to validate and route. Without a valid tasks array, validation fails and the task raises.

id.description: Task identifier; normalized to a safe slug if needed.

dependsOn.description: IDs of tasks that must complete before this one.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Criteria the task's work must satisfy; required to be non-empty.

checks.description: Blocking check commands for this task.

openspecTaskRefs.description: Non-empty OpenSpec tasks.md references this task implements.

recommendedMode.description: Planner's recommended execution mode, e.g. campaign or parallel.

risks.description: Planner-identified risks; certain keywords (migration, rollout, attached, managed, cross-cutting) force campaign mode.

maxTasks.description: Maximum number of tasks accepted in the plan before validation fails.

maxParallelism.description: Maximum concurrent subtasks allowed for parallel mode; more tasks than this forces campaign mode.

executionMode.description: Force parallel/campaign routing, or auto-detect from confidence, risk keywords, and task-graph safety. Forcing parallel requires a dependency-free, file-disjoint plan within maxParallelism.

changeId.description: OpenSpec change id, interpolated into the generated coding-agent instruction text.

supplementalInstruction.description: Extra text appended to the generated instruction for the coding agent.

valid.description: Always true on the success path; invalid plans raise instead.

recommendedMode.description: Mode the deterministic auto-router would have chosen.

confidence.description: Planner confidence carried through from the assessment.

rationale.description: Planner rationale carried through from the assessment.

risks.description: Planner-identified risks carried through from the assessment.

tasks.description: Validated tasks with normalized ids, dependsOn, files, acceptanceCriteria, checks, and openspecTaskRefs.

parallelPlan.description: Subtask list shaped for parallel (code_parallel) execution.

description.description: Task description with acceptance criteria and OpenSpec task refs appended.

instruction.description: Generated instruction text for the coding agent, referencing the OpenSpec change and normalized plan.
